description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh：中文。

- en：英文。

默认：en
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.

- en: English.

Default value: en.

description.zh: 修改之后的备注内容（不填则设置Remark为空）。
description.en: The new remark. To clear the remark, set this parameter to an empty string.
The IP address of the client.
The unique ID of the zone.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz update-zone-remark --lang en --zone-id df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --remark test --user-client-ip 127.0.XX.XX --client-token 21079fa016944979537637959d09bc --region cn-hangzhou
